description: Search public Snapchat Explore results by keyword. Choose one result family or collect everything Snapchat returns. No login or proxy setup is required.

maxResultsPerQuery.description: Records returned for each query in the selected page window. Legacy maxResults and maxItems inputs are still accepted in code.
maxResultsPerQuery.title: Results per query

mode.description: Result family to return. 'Users' includes both Snapchat user cards and public profiles; 'Profiles' returns public profiles only.
mode.title: What to collect

page.description: Snapchat exposes one fixed result set per query with no cursor. Page 1 returns the first maxResultsPerQuery records, page 2 the next batch, and so on. Legacy startPage is still accepted in code.
page.title: Result page

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy override. Direct access works by default; no proxy is required.
proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy configuration

queries.description: One or more public Snapchat Explore keywords, e.g. food, travel, selenagomez. Legacy keywords, query, searchQueries and searchTerms inputs are still accepted in code.
queries.title: Search queries

title: Snapchat Explore Search Input
